events.text: He joined the Royal Canadian Air Force in Trenton, Ontario.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he joined the Royal Canadian Air Force in Trenton , Ontario in July 1939

events.text: He earned his wings as a pilot in Trenton.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He earned his wings as a pilot in Trenton in 1939

events.text: He completed the flying instructor course at Camp Borden.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He completed the flying instructor course at Camp Borden in 1939

events.text: He was posted overseas as C.O. of No. 408 Bomber Squadron, 6 Bomber Group.
events.subject: self
events.quote: being posted overseas as C.O . of No . 408 Bomber Squadron , 6 Bomber Group 26 November 1944

events.text: He won a Distinguished Flying Cross (DFC) with No. 408 Goose Squadron.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He won a Distinguished Flying Cross ( DFC ) on 4 May 1945 with No . 408 Goose Squadron
